notes: Most symmetric frame in the set after d072: 21 px near reveal against 22 px far, 45 px and 35 px of frame face, and the frame paint is within 4 lum of the leaf (0.97) so the whole opening reads as one grey. Light bows rather than falls: the tone profile peaks at mid height (1.00) and drops to 0.53 at the head and 0.59 at the foot. One fine vertical groove at x 0.68 running y 0.06 to 0.89, and a flat pale pull bar at x 0.24 whose highlight clips to #FFFAF5, so its finish is inferred as brushed steel rather than measured. The 15 px dark band on the right is the unfilled construction joint between frame and stone, not a thrown shadow.
